name: market_state_classifier_v1
mechanism: NIFTY's intraday order flow alternates between institutional TWAP/VWAP-driven trending phases (persistent directional imbalance visible as rising 2-minute ADX) and market-maker-driven ranging phases (tight oscillation as gamma-hedgers quote both sides within a narrow band). When NIFTY ADX(24) rises above 22 with contained ATR acceleration, it signals institutional directional programs are active — a short EMA crossover (EMA12 crossing EMA36) aligned with VWAP confirms the next 30-50 spot point leg has begun. Conversely, when ADX(24) falls below 18 and Bollinger Band width sits in the bottom 40th percentile of its 5-minute history, market makers are the marginal price-setters — price touching the outer band immediately encounters their resting contra-side hedging flow, producing reliable 15-25 spot point mean-reversion within 30-60 seconds.
core_signal_oneliner: ADX-based regime classifier switching between EMA-crossover momentum entries (trending) and Bollinger Band extreme mean-reversion entries (ranging)
